bagTips.text: Pack one bag per family member if possible; keep it lightweight and easy to carry.
Store the bag near the front door or entryway so it's grabbed quickly in the dark.
Suggested maximum weight per bag: about 15 kg for men, 10 kg for women.
Check and update the bag's contents every six months — watch expiry dates on food, medication and masks.
Store batteries alongside devices, not inside them, to avoid leakage or corrosion; swap in fresh ones periodically.
If you carry a power bank, recharge it every 2–3 months so it's ready when needed.
